items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I wrote for Harry James' orchestra when he first started out

ctx.x: -- of the things Benny Goodman played with his sextet when he and Teddy Wilson and Gene Krupa were all in the band. And I wrote for Benny Goodman's orchestra because I played with Benny Goodman's orchestra about a year and a half and I was doing some arranging for that. And I wrote for Harry James' orchestra when he first started out, when he left Benny Goodman to go on his own. And he went to Philadelphia to open up there and then I'm doing some writing now and also one of the [ASSOCIATE] directors and arrangers…
